title: Checkout API elevated errors in region-a
impact: Approximately 18% of checkout requests in region-a are returning HTTP 5xx; other regions appear healthy based on current telemetry.
facts: Checkout 5xx rate in region-a increased from below 1% to approximately 18% at 09:04 UTC+7 according to service telemetry.
A checkout-api deployment completed in region-a at 08:58 UTC+7.
Synthetic checkout in region-b is currently passing.

hypotheses.statement: The 08:58 checkout-api deployment introduced a region-a-specific connection-pool regression.
evidence_for: Error increase began within minutes of the deployment and only in the deployed region.
hypotheses.next_test: Compare pool saturation and connection timeout traces before and after deployment; compare region-a with region-b.

unknowns: Whether failed checkout attempts created duplicate payment intents.
Whether database connection saturation is limited to checkout-api or shared by other services.

tasks.goal: Compare checkout-api connection-pool telemetry before and after the deployment.
tasks.expected_output: Evidence supporting, weakening, or falsifying the deployment regression hypothesis.

tasks.goal: Check for duplicate payment intents associated with failed requests.
tasks.expected_output: Read-only reconciliation result and data-integrity risk assessment.

tasks.goal: Prepare an internal incident status update from verified facts.

decisions.decision: Freeze nonessential checkout-api production changes in region-a during investigation.
decisions.rationale: Additional changes would increase uncertainty while impact remains active.
decisions.approval: Operational coordination decision; no production change executed by the AI role.

risks: Potential duplicate payment intent creation has not yet been ruled out.
Rollback has not yet been reviewed for database/schema compatibility.
